name: Filterable table
domReason: Light DOM retains static content, native semantics, label relationships and host composition without duplicating controls.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disable the native controls owned by this instance.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Mark the primary control busy and prevent duplicate activation.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Delegates disabled state to native children.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Native control name; application form keys remain explicit.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reconnect behavior after replacing native child structure.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the first usable native control.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sort existing native rows by a column.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filter existing rows by literal text.

variants.name: Nothing matches
variants.description: A search term no component matches; the table body is its empty row, an empty-state block offers Clear filters, and the count reads zero.

variants.name: Loading
variants.description: The table carries aria-busy; its body is the ⋯ row and the search field shows the loading glyph.
